quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the impact of assistant coach Phil Handy
quotes.excerpt: Phil Handy has been great just cleaning things up, polishing things, talking through different coverages.
quotes.quote: Phil Handy has been great just cleaning things up, polishing things, talking through different coverages, different systems through the season. He has a very high IQ. He has been in the game for a long time. He has won a few championships and he worked with one of my favorite players of all time, so it has been great working with Phil.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown praises assistant coach Phil Handy for his high IQ and ability to polish the team systems saying it has been great working with him

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the injury status of Andre Drummond
quotes.excerpt: Andre Drummond is such a great guy, such a great communicator. I hope it is nothing too severe.
quotes.quote: Andre Drummond is such a great guy, such a great communicator. I hope it is nothing too severe. I guess they are going to get some second imaging and stuff like that, but Andre Drummond has been a joy to have. He has been great in the locker room, so it sucks to see a guy like that go down.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says Andre Drummond is undergoing further imaging on his injury and admits it sucks to see a guy like that go down

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the veteran presence of Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: I have played against Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for a long time and every single one he has been a dog.
quotes.quote: I have played against Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for a long time and every single one he has been a dog. Guards, takes the tough matchups, guards the best player. He has guarded me a lot of times. His shots when he is open and also just is a great connector for your team, so I am looking forward to being on the same side of him this year and we look forward to his leadership.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown is looking forward to playing alongside Kentavious Caldwell-Pope calling him a dog who guards the best player and serves as a great connector

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the team's offensive pace and spacing
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot of guys who have speed and can be guys off the bounce creating an advantage.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of guys who have speed and can be guys off the bounce creating an advantage. We got to continue to encourage to just throw it ahead and once you beat your guy make the right play and just it creates more space, it makes us harder to guard. We got so many talented players, we want to make sure that we keep that ball moving and hopping and we playing with a certain pace.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says the key for the team is to keep the ball moving and playing with pace to take advantage of their speed and playmaking ability
